y <- as.numeric(data$`Monthly Anomaly`)

data.ts <- ts(
  y,
  start = c(1850, 1),
  frequency = 12
)

# plot seluruh data
plot.ts(
  data.ts,
  main = "Plot Monthly Anomaly",
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Monthly Anomaly"
)

# Pembagian data train dan test

n <- length(data.ts)
n.train <- floor(0.80 * n)

train <- window(
  data.ts,
  start = c(1850, 1),
  end = c(1988, 5)
)

test <- window(
  data.ts,
  start = c(1988, 6),
  end = c(2023, 1)
)

length(train)
## [1] 1661
cat("Jumlah data train: ", length(train), "\n")
## Jumlah data train:  1661
length(test)
## [1] 416
cat("Jumlah data test: ", length(test), "\n")
## Jumlah data test:  416
# cek periode
start(train)
## [1] 1850    1
cat("Periode data train mulai: ", start(train), "\n")
## Periode data train mulai:  1850 1
end(train)
## [1] 1988    5
cat("Periode data train selesai: ", end(train), "\n")
## Periode data train selesai:  1988 5
start(test)
## [1] 1988    6
cat("Periode data test mulai: ", start(test), "\n")
## Periode data test mulai:  1988 6
end(test)
## [1] 2023    1
cat("Periode data test selesai: ", end(test), "\n")
## Periode data test selesai:  2023 1
plot(
  train,
  main = "Data Train Monthly Anomaly",
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Monthly Anomaly"
)

plot(
  test,
  main = "Data Test Monthly Anomaly",
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Monthly Anomaly"
)

Cek Stasioneritas

Dalam rataan

acf(
  train,
  main = "ACF Data Train"
)

# ADF
adf.train <- adf.test(train)
## Warning in adf.test(train): p-value smaller than printed p-value
adf.train
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  train
## Dickey-Fuller = -6.2432, Lag order = 11, p-value = 0.01
## alternative hypothesis: stationary

Karena p-value < 0.05, maka data train stasioner dalam rataan.

Dalam ragam

index <- 1:length(train)

# cek minimum
min(train)
## [1] -0.97
# konstanta penggeser
c <- abs(min(train)) + 1

train.shift <- train + c

min(train.shift)
## [1] 1
bc <- boxcox(
  train.shift ~ index,
  lambda = seq(-2, 2, by = 0.1)
)

plot(bc)

Interval berada pada angka 1, sehingga tidak perlu dilakukan transformasi. Data train stasioner dalam ragam.

Identifikasi Model

acf(
  train,
  lag.max = 30,
  main = "ACF Data Train"
)

pacf(
  train,
  lag.max = 30,
  main = "PACF Data Train"
)

# EACF
eacf(train)
## AR/MA

Analisis Residual

model.final <- model_201

res <- residuals(model.final)

# Plot residual
plot(
  res,
  main = "Residual ARIMA(2,0,1)",
  ylab = "Residual",
  xlab = "Waktu"
)

# ACF residual
acf(
  res,
  main = "ACF Residual ARIMA(2,0,1)"
)

# PACF residual
pacf(
  res,
  main = "PACF Residual ARIMA(2,0,1)"
)

Box.test(
  res,
  lag = 20,
  type = "Ljung-Box",
  fitdf = 3
)
## 
##  Box-Ljung test
## 
## data:  res
## X-squared = 29.857, df = 17, p-value = 0.0274
Box.test(
  res^2,
  lag = 20,
  type = "Ljung-Box",
  fitdf = 3
)
## 
##  Box-Ljung test
## 
## data:  res^2
## X-squared = 72.343, df = 17, p-value = 8.488e-09
t.test(res, mu = 0)
## 
##  One Sample t-test
## 
## data:  res
## t = 0.32209, df = 1660, p-value = 0.7474
## alternative hypothesis: true mean is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  -0.007444715  0.010370217
## sample estimates:
##   mean of x 
## 0.001462751
ks.test(
  as.numeric(scale(res)),
  "pnorm"
)
## 
##  Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  as.numeric(scale(res))
## D = 0.022249, p-value = 0.3834
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)

# Analisis residual model baru

model.final <- model_201

# Residual
res <- residuals(model.final)

# Plot residual
plot(
  res,
  main = "Residual ARIMA(2,0,1)",
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Residual"
)

# ACF residual
acf(
  res,
  lag.max = 30,
  main = "ACF Residual ARIMA(2,0,1)"
)

# PACF residual
pacf(
  res,
  lag.max = 30,
  main = "PACF Residual ARIMA(2,0,1)"
)

lb.res <- Box.test(
  res,
  lag = 20,
  type = "Ljung-Box",
  fitdf = 3
)

lb.res
## 
##  Box-Ljung test
## 
## data:  res
## X-squared = 29.857, df = 17, p-value = 0.0274
lb.res2 <- Box.test(
  res^2,
  lag = 20,
  type = "Ljung-Box",
  fitdf = 3
)

lb.res2
## 
##  Box-Ljung test
## 
## data:  res^2
## X-squared = 72.343, df = 17, p-value = 8.488e-09
t.test(res, mu = 0)
## 
##  One Sample t-test
## 
## data:  res
## t = 0.32209, df = 1660, p-value = 0.7474
## alternative hypothesis: true mean is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  -0.007444715  0.010370217
## sample estimates:
##   mean of x 
## 0.001462751
qqnorm(
  res,
  main = "QQ Plot Residual ARIMA(2,0,1)"
)

qqline(res)

ks.test(
  as.numeric(scale(res)),
  "pnorm"
)
## 
##  Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  as.numeric(scale(res))
## D = 0.022249, p-value = 0.3834
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided
cat("Ljung-Box residual p-value:",
    lb.res$p.value, "\n")
## Ljung-Box residual p-value: 0.02739709
cat("Ljung-Box residual kuadrat p-value:",
    lb.res2$p.value, "\n")
## Ljung-Box residual kuadrat p-value: 8.487722e-09
cat("Uji t residual p-value:",
    t.test(res, mu = 0)$p.value, "\n")
## Uji t residual p-value: 0.7474229
cat("KS normalitas p-value:",
    ks.test(as.numeric(scale(res)), "pnorm")$p.value, "\n")
## KS normalitas p-value: 0.383444

Cek Overfitting

model_301 <- Arima(
  train,
  order = c(3,0,1),
  method = "ML"
)

model_202 <- Arima(
  train,
  order = c(2,0,2),
  method = "ML"
)
coeftest(model_301)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##            Estimate Std. Error  z value  Pr(>|z|)    
## ar1        1.214413   0.048929  24.8199 < 2.2e-16 ***
## ar2       -0.188408   0.040314  -4.6735  2.96e-06 ***
## ar3       -0.042911   0.034512  -1.2434   0.21373    
## ma1       -0.825241   0.041550 -19.8616 < 2.2e-16 ***
## intercept -0.119706   0.045901  -2.6079   0.00911 ** 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
coeftest(model_202)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##            Estimate Std. Error z value  Pr(>|z|)    
## ar1        1.475499   0.279587  5.2774  1.31e-07 ***
## ar2       -0.485872   0.268747 -1.8079 0.0706191 .  
## ma1       -1.088152   0.288197 -3.7757 0.0001595 ***
## ma2        0.201281   0.195203  1.0311 0.3024784    
## intercept -0.115818   0.048376 -2.3941 0.0166593 *  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
AIC_overfit <- data.frame(
  Model = c(
    "ARIMA(2,0,1)",
    "ARIMA(3,0,1)",
    "ARIMA(2,0,2)"
  ),
  AIC = c(
    AIC(model.final),
    AIC(model_301),
    AIC(model_202)
  )
)

AIC_overfit[order(AIC_overfit$AIC), ]
##          Model       AIC
## 1 ARIMA(2,0,1) -880.0729
## 3 ARIMA(2,0,2) -880.0130
## 2 ARIMA(3,0,1) -879.6449

ARIMA(2,0,1) dipertahankan sebagai model final karena memiliki nilai AIC paling rendah dibandingkan model overfit ARIMA(3,0,1) dan ARIMA(2,0,2), serta seluruh parameternya signifikan. Penambahan orde AR atau MA tidak memberikan perbaikan model berdasarkan AIC dan justru menghasilkan parameter yang tidak signifikan pada model yang lebih kompleks.

Forecasting

model.final <- model_201

forecast.final <- forecast(
  model.final,
  h = length(test)
)

hasil_arima <- data.frame(
  Waktu = time(test),
  Aktual = as.numeric(test),
  Forecast = as.numeric(forecast.final$mean)
)

ggplot(
  hasil_arima,
  aes(x = Waktu)
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = Aktual,
      color = "Aktual"
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = Forecast,
      color = "Forecast ARIMA"
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Forecast ARIMA(2,0,1)",
    x = "Tahun",
    y = "Monthly Anomaly",
    color = "Keterangan"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
## Don't know how to automatically pick scale for object of type <ts>. Defaulting

Evaluasi Model

forecast_value <- as.numeric(forecast.final$mean)
actual_value <- as.numeric(test)

# RMSE
RMSE <- sqrt(
  mean((actual_value - forecast_value)^2)
)

# MAE
MAE <- mean(
  abs(actual_value - forecast_value)
)

##                  Model       AIC
## 4 ARIMA(2,1,2) + drift -894.7310
## 3 ARIMA(1,1,2) + drift -886.2210
## 2 ARIMA(2,1,1) + drift -869.6831
## 1 ARIMA(1,1,1) + drift -865.2219
cek_residual <- function(model) {
  
  res <- residuals(model)
  
  lb <- Box.test(
    res,
    lag = 20,
    type = "Ljung-Box",
    fitdf = length(coef(model))
  )
  
  lb2 <- Box.test(
    res^2,
    lag = 20,
    type = "Ljung-Box",
    fitdf = length(coef(model))
  )
  
  t_res <- t.test(res, mu = 0)
  
  data.frame(
    AIC = AIC(model),
    LB_Residual = lb$p.value,
    LB_Residual_Kuadrat = lb2$p.value,
    Mean_Residual = mean(res),
    P_Mean = t_res$p.value
  )
}

Evaluasi Model Sarima

forecast_value <- as.numeric(forecast.final$mean)
actual_value <- as.numeric(test)

RMSE <- sqrt(
  mean((actual_value - forecast_value)^2)
)

MAE <- mean(
  abs(actual_value - forecast_value)
)

cat("RMSE :", RMSE, "\n")
